description: Circle CCTP (USDC cross-chain transfer) fast-burn allowance and the fee tiers for one source-to-destination domain pair. Narrowed: the attestation status of a specific transfer needs its burn transaction hash, which this tool does not take, so per-transfer attestation is not reported. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

destination.description: CCTP destination domain id, e.g. 6 = Base (default 6)

source.description: CCTP source domain id, e.g. 0 = Ethereum (default 0)

name: crypto_circle_cctp_transfers
title: Crypto Circle Cctp Transfers
